001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import java.math.BigDecimal;
004import org.clafer.common.Check;
005
006/**
007 * A constant decimal, as written in the model. Type analysis replaces it with
008 * an {@link AstConstant} of {@link AstDecimalClafer} holding the value scaled
009 * to the decimal scale of the model.
010 *
011 * @author Michał Antkiewicz
012 */
013public record AstDecimalConstant(BigDecimal value) implements AstSetExpr {
014
015    public AstDecimalConstant {
016        value = Check.notNull(value);
017    }
018
019    @Override
020    public String toString() {
021        return value.toPlainString();
022    }
023}
